# opnsense_interfaces_assignment (Resource)

Assigns a physical or virtual device to an OPNsense logical interface and manages its basic IPv4/IPv6 configuration.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device` (String) Physical or virtual device, for example `vtnet1`, `vlan01`, or `vxlan0`.
- `ipv4` (Attributes) IPv4 address mode and mode-specific settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipv4))
- `ipv6` (Attributes) IPv6 address mode and mode-specific settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipv6))

### Optional

- `allow_readdress` (Boolean) Explicitly allow changes to the assigned device or address configuration. Keep disabled for the management interface unless an alternate management path is available.
- `block_bogons` (Boolean) Block bogon networks on this interface.
- `block_private` (Boolean) Block private networks on this interface.
- `description` (String) Interface description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable the interface.
- `gateway_interface` (Boolean) Mark the interface as a gateway interface.
- `locked` (Boolean) Prevent deletion of the assignment in OPNsense.
- `mss` (Number) TCP MSS adjustment.
- `mtu` (Number) Interface MTU.
- `promiscuous` (Boolean) Enable promiscuous mode.
- `spoof_mac` (String) Optional spoofed MAC address.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Logical OPNsense interface name used as the import identifier.
- `name` (String) Logical OPNsense interface name, for example `lan` or `opt1`.

<a id="nestedatt--ipv4"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ipv4`

Required:

- `mode` (String) IPv4 mode: `none`, `static`, or `dhcp`.

Optional:

- `address` (String) Static IPv4 address.
- `alias_address` (String) DHCP alias IPv4 address.
- `alias_prefix` (Number) DHCP alias prefix length.
- `dhcp_hostname` (String) DHCP client hostname.
- `gateway` (String) IPv4 gateway reference.
- `prefix` (Number) Static IPv4 prefix length.
- `reject_from` (String) Comma-separated DHCP servers to reject.


<a id="nestedatt--ipv6"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ipv6`

Required:

- `mode` (String) IPv6 mode.

Optional:

- `address` (String) Static IPv6 address.
- `gateway` (String) IPv6 gateway reference.
- `ia_pd_length` (Number) DHCPv6 IA-PD prefix length.
- `ia_pd_send_hint` (Boolean) Send the configured IA-PD length as a hint.
- `prefix` (Number) Static IPv6 prefix length.
- `prefix_only` (Boolean) Request only a delegated prefix.
- `track_associated_pd` (Number) Associated delegated-prefix index.
- `track_interface` (String) Interface tracked by `track6` or `idassoc6`.
- `track_prefix_id` (Number) Tracked prefix ID.
- `use_ipv4_interface` (Boolean) Use the IPv4 interface for DHCPv6.
- `vlan_priority` (Number) DHCPv6 VLAN priority.
